description: Sequencer of four rows of notes, with bridges between the rows that skip, mute, ratchet, borrow, swap or jump between them

params.text: Sets the length of that row; above 8 the row ping-pongs, repeating the note at each end
Attenuates and inverts that row's length CV before it is added to the row length
Sets the chance that a bridge in that row applies its effect to the notes in the two rows it joins
Attenuates and inverts that odds CV before it is added to the odds setting
Clicking steps that note through the chosen scale; right-clicking opens a menu for setting any note, randomizing, and changing the scale or root
Clicking steps that bridge through its effects: none, skip, mute, ratchet, borrow, swap and jump; right-clicking sets the effect directly
Sets which row the sequence starts on, and offsets every playhead when the play head expander is attached
Attenuates and inverts the start row CV before it is added to the start row

inputs.text: Raises or lowers that row's length through its attenuverter
Raises or lowers those odds through its attenuverter
Advances the sequence one step on each rising edge
Returns the sequence to its first step and returns every setting to the state last chosen by hand
Raises or lowers the start row through its attenuverter

outputs.text: Carries the gate of the note being played
Carries the pitch of the note being played, and holds its last value while a note is muted
Carries a gate on the first step after the sequence reaches its end
Carries a gate while the sequence is ratcheting
Carries a gate while a note is muted

notes: Bypassing this module connects the clock input to the gate output
The sequence moves only on a rising edge at the clock input, so with nothing patched there the module holds its first note
menu: Set Scale — picks the scale the notes come from and randomizes every note on the module
Root Note — changes the root and shifts every entered note by the interval between the old root and the new one
Range — sets how many octaves the notes span, centred on the fifth above the root
Ratchet Speed — sets how fast a ratchet plays: whole notes match the clock, half notes twice per clock, quarter notes four times
Randomize Notes — randomizes every note within the chosen scale, or shifts some of the notes an octave up or down
Active Cursor Color — picks the colour of the ring that marks the note being played
Add Expander — creates the play head expander, which adds three more playheads, or the randomizer expander, which adds buttons and triggers that randomize notes; each goes to the right
Bridges — initializes every bridge to no effect, or randomizes all of them
